rev.t: Bargain Book Hut at Mantri Square is a great place for book lovers, but it’s the staff that makes it truly special. Priya (Sevvandhi) provided stellar service by helping me secure a signed copy of Sudha Murthys’ latest book for my daughter. …

Bargain Book Hut at Mantri Square Mall is a haven for book lovers. With an impressive collection spanning every genre—from gripping bestsellers to timeless literary classics—it promises something for every reader. …

We have visited this shope recently to buy latest hotwheels to my collection, they have new hotwheels and majorette models in display , and a wide collection of books , its an amazing place for all hotwheels buyers , special thanks to Matiur Rehman khan for his effort to making the availability of all latest models .
